head_commit.message:
[Issue #9245] Change sort order of saved opportunities (#9400)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes #9245

## Changes proposed

<!-- What was added, updated, or removed in this PR. -->
Changed `_build_saved_union_subquery` to use two separate aggregated
subqueries (user saves and org saves) joined with a full outer join,
replacing the previous UNION ALL query

Sort value is `COALESCE(user_saved_at, org_saved_at)`, so a user's
personal save timestamp always takes priority

Updated `test_user_and_org_save_timestamp_precedence` to assert the new
correct behavior

Added two new tests: `test_org_only_save_uses_org_timestamp_for_sort`
and `test_user_save_timestamp_beats_org_save_timestamp`

## Context for reviewers

<!-- Technical or background context, more in-depth details of the
implementation, and anything else you'd like reviewers to know about
that will help them understand the changes in the PR. -->
Previously the subquery used `MAX(created_at)` across both user and org
saves via a UNION ALL, so if an org shared an opportunity after the user
saved it, that opportunity would jump to the top of the list. The fix
uses a full outer join between two separately aggregated subqueries,
then `COALESCE`s the results — user timestamp when present, org
timestamp otherwise. The NULLs come from the join itself so no typed
casting is needed.



## Validation steps

<!-- Manual testing instructions, as well as any helpful references
(screenshots, GIF demos, code examples or output). -->
See new unit tests covering sort behavior.

For UAT: Save several opportunities, share one with an org, confirm it
does not reorder in the list
